style.name: Memphis
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Memphis design for global-news posters, using playful geometric forms, bold black outlines, vivid coral, cobalt, lemon yellow, teal and cream, energetic editorial grids, squiggles and pattern accents, while keeping facts, maps, diagrams and data dominant and highly legible.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 八个信号把关税、AI、地震、战争与气候推上同一张风险图
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营者要同时重算成本、责任、韧性与增长节奏
zh-CN.headlineFull: 八个信号把关税、AI、地震、战争与气候推上同一张风险图；经营者要同时重算成本、责任、韧性与增长节奏
zh-CN.intro: 美加贸易谈判逼近新期限，AI法律核验责任与创作者工具改变工作流；秘鲁地震、伊朗经济施压、哥伦比亚救援、欧洲野火风险和卫星制造融资构成今天的全球观察面。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 热点真正进入经营，是在它改变成本、责任、供应链或安全边界的那一刻。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把八个信号摊开，再圈出今天必须行动的一格。

en-US.headlineFact: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, earthquakes, war and climate on one risk map
en-US.headlineView: operators must recalculate cost, responsibility, resilience and growth pace together
en-US.headlineFull: Eight signals put tariffs, AI, earthquakes, war and climate on one risk map; operators must recalculate cost, responsibility, resilience and growth pace together
en-US.intro: US-Canada trade talks approach a new deadline as AI verification duties and creator tools reshape workflows; a Peru earthquake, economic pressure on Iran, Colombia relief, European wildfire risk and satellite-manufacturing finance complete today's global picture.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A headline enters operations when it changes cost, responsibility, the supply chain or a safety boundary.
en-US.doudouQuote: Lay out the eight signals, then circle the box that needs action today.

sources.title: Canada and US resume tariff talks as deadline looms

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美加恢复关税谈判并逼近新的协议期限
zh-CN.headlineView: 跨境卖家仍要按最坏税率锁住报价、入境节点与退货责任
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美加恢复关税谈判并逼近新的协议期限；跨境卖家仍要按最坏税率锁住报价、入境节点与退货责任
zh-CN.intro: 加拿大与美国恢复贸易谈判，双方称协议接近但仍有工作要做；在最终税率与执行日期明确前，卖家需要核对原产地、税则号、清关时间、DDP报价、承运商垫付和退货成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 谈判接近完成不等于成本已经确定，报价必须能承受最后一刻的条款变化。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先把税率和入境日写进表格，再决定包邮还是改价。

en-US.headlineFact: The US and Canada resumed tariff talks as a new deadline approaches
en-US.headlineView: cross-border sellers should still price for the worst case and lock entry and return liability
en-US.headlineFull: The US and Canada resumed tariff talks as a new deadline approaches; cross-border sellers should still price for the worst case and lock entry and return liability
en-US.intro: Canada and the United States resumed trade talks, saying a deal is close but more work remains; until final rates and effective dates are clear, sellers should verify origin, tariff codes, customs timing, DDP quotes, carrier advances and return costs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A nearly finished negotiation is not a fixed cost; quotes must survive last-minute terms.
en-US.doudouQuote: Put the rate and entry date in the sheet before choosing free shipping or a new price.

sources.title: Canada and US resume talks over tariffs as deadline looms

zh-CN.headlineFact: 加州法院因AI虚假引文处罚律师并重申本人核验责任
zh-CN.headlineView: 把检索交给AI或助理都不能外包最终签字人的专业义务
zh-CN.headlineFull: 加州法院因AI虚假引文处罚律师并重申本人核验责任；把检索交给AI或助理都不能外包最终签字人的专业义务
zh-CN.intro: 一名律师因文件引用不存在的案例受到法院处罚，并辩称AI核验交给了助理；裁决强调提交者必须亲自确认引文、事实与来源，企业也应为AI产出设置可追溯的复核和签字节点。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI可以加速初稿，但不能替最终责任人确认事实、来源和结论。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 谁按下提交键，谁就要看见每一条证据链。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: A California court sanctioned a lawyer over fake AI citations and reaffirmed personal verification
en-US.headlineView: delegating research to AI or staff cannot outsource the signer's professional duty
en-US.headlineFull: A California court sanctioned a lawyer over fake AI citations and reaffirmed personal verification; delegating research to AI or staff cannot outsource the signer's professional duty
en-US.intro: A lawyer was sanctioned after a filing cited nonexistent cases and argued that AI checking had been delegated to a paralegal; the ruling stresses that the filer must verify citations, facts and sources, a lesson for every business using AI-generated work.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI can accelerate a draft, but it cannot replace the final owner's verification of facts, sources and conclusions.
en-US.doudouQuote: Whoever presses submit must be able to see every link in the evidence chain.

sources.title: California court sanctions attorney over AI citation verification

zh-CN.headlineFact: Meta推出面向创作者与小企业的新Mac应用
zh-CN.headlineView: 桌面端内容、沟通与客户运营正被压缩进更短的工作流
zh-CN.headlineFull: Meta推出面向创作者与小企业的新Mac应用；桌面端内容、沟通与客户运营正被压缩进更短的工作流
zh-CN.intro: Meta的新Mac应用把目标对准创作者和小企业，试图让内容处理、消息与业务触点更贴近桌面工作；一人公司应优先测试能否减少切换、加快回复并保留客户数据出口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 新工具的价值不在多一个入口，而在一个人能否少切换、快交付并守住客户关系。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 少开三个窗口，才算真的省下一段时间。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: Meta launched a new Mac app aimed at creators and small businesses
en-US.headlineView: desktop content, communication and customer operations are compressing into shorter workflows
en-US.headlineFull: Meta launched a new Mac app aimed at creators and small businesses; desktop content, communication and customer operations are compressing into shorter workflows
en-US.intro: Meta's new Mac app targets creators and small businesses by bringing content work, messaging and business touchpoints closer to the desktop; solo operators should test whether it reduces switching, speeds replies and preserves a customer-data exit.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A new tool matters when one operator can switch less, deliver faster and still own the customer relationship.
en-US.doudouQuote: Closing three extra windows is when the time saving becomes real.

sources.title: Meta's new Mac app takes aim at creators and small businesses

zh-CN.headlineFact: 秘鲁南部安第斯发生6.7级地震
zh-CN.headlineView: 初期无重大损失报告，山区通信、道路与余震仍需持续核查
zh-CN.headlineFull: 秘鲁南部安第斯发生6.7级地震；初期无重大损失报告，山区通信、道路与余震仍需持续核查
zh-CN.intro: 一场6.7级地震撼动秘鲁南部安第斯地区，初步没有重大损失报告；偏远社区的通信覆盖、道路通行、建筑受损和后续余震监测将决定完整风险评估。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 没有立即报告损失只是第一帧，真正的判断要等偏远地区也完成回报。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图上安静的地方，也可能只是信号还没回来。

en-US.headlineFact: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake shook Peru's southern Andes
en-US.headlineView: no major damage was reported initially, but roads, communications and aftershocks still require checks
en-US.headlineFull: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake shook Peru's southern Andes; no major damage was reported initially, but roads, communications and aftershocks still require checks
en-US.intro: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake rattled Peru's southern Andes with no immediate reports of major damage; communications in remote communities, road access, structural checks and aftershock monitoring will shape the full assessment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: No immediate damage report is only the first frame; the picture is complete when remote areas report back.
en-US.doudouQuote: A quiet spot on the map may simply mean the signal has not returned.

sources.title: Magnitude 6.7 earthquake shakes Peru's southern Andes

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国威胁孤立伊朗贸易伙伴并加码经济施压
zh-CN.headlineView: 二级制裁风险正从能源交易扩散到银行、航运与供应链审查
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国威胁孤立伊朗贸易伙伴并加码经济施压；二级制裁风险正从能源交易扩散到银行、航运与供应链审查
zh-CN.intro: 美国官员警告与伊朗保持贸易往来的盟友和企业可能面临经济后果，军事打击正在让位于更强的金融与贸易压力；跨国企业需要重新检查付款路径、船舶、保险和最终受益人。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 经济战的边界不止在被制裁国家，也会沿着付款、运输和所有权链条向外扩散。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 货没去伊朗，也要看钱和船是不是绕过那里。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：伊朗经济施压。

en-US.headlineFact: The US threatened Iran's trade partners as economic pressure intensifies
en-US.headlineView: secondary-sanctions risk is spreading from energy trades to banks, shipping and supply-chain screening
en-US.headlineFull: The US threatened Iran's trade partners as economic pressure intensifies; secondary-sanctions risk is spreading from energy trades to banks, shipping and supply-chain screening
en-US.intro: US officials warned allies and companies trading with Iran of economic consequences as military strikes give way to stronger financial and trade pressure; global firms need renewed checks on payment routes, vessels, insurance and beneficial owners.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The boundary of economic warfare extends beyond the target country through payments, transport and ownership chains.
en-US.doudouQuote: Even if the cargo avoids Iran, check whether the money or vessel passes through its network.

sources.title: US threatens Iran trade partners as economic pressure intensifies

zh-CN.headlineFact: 哥伦比亚地震后约120万人需要援助
zh-CN.headlineView: 偏远社区仍难抵达，救援重点转向通路、供水、医疗与临时安置
zh-CN.headlineFull: 哥伦比亚地震后约120万人需要援助；偏远社区仍难抵达，救援重点转向通路、供水、医疗与临时安置
zh-CN.intro: 联合国表示，哥伦比亚地震后约120万人需要援助，一些社区仍因道路和通信中断难以抵达；下一阶段必须同时恢复交通、饮水、医疗服务、信息登记和安全住所。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 灾后数字越大，越要把援助拆成一条条能抵达最后一公里的路线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 物资已经出发，不等于受灾的人已经收到。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：哥伦比亚救援。

en-US.headlineFact: About 1.2 million people need aid after Colombia's earthquake
en-US.headlineView: remote communities remain hard to reach as relief shifts to access, water, health care and shelter
en-US.headlineFull: About 1.2 million people need aid after Colombia's earthquake; remote communities remain hard to reach as relief shifts to access, water, health care and shelter
en-US.intro: The United Nations says about 1.2 million people need assistance after Colombia's earthquake, with some communities still cut off by damaged roads and communications; the next phase must restore access, water, health services, registration and safe shelter together.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The larger the disaster number, the more relief must be broken into routes that actually reach the last mile.
en-US.doudouQuote: Supplies leaving a warehouse does not mean affected families have received them.

sources.title: Colombia earthquake leaves 1.2 million needing aid

zh-CN.headlineFact: 研究称即使最佳气候情景下欧洲野火仍可能增加39%
zh-CN.headlineView: 防火预算必须从季节应急转向长期植被、社区与电网适应
zh-CN.headlineFull: 研究称即使最佳气候情景下欧洲野火仍可能增加39%；防火预算必须从季节应急转向长期植被、社区与电网适应
zh-CN.intro: 一项研究警告，即使在较乐观的气候情景下，欧洲野火仍可能增加约39%；政府需要把资源从单一灭火能力扩展到可燃物管理、预警、疏散、建筑标准和电力设施韧性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当风险曲线长期抬升，最有效的投入往往发生在火焰出现之前。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 多一条防火带，可能少一条撤离线。

en-US.headlineFact: A study says European wildfires could rise 39% even in the best climate scenario
en-US.headlineView: fire budgets must move from seasonal response to long-term landscape, community and grid adaptation
en-US.headlineFull: A study says European wildfires could rise 39% even in the best climate scenario; fire budgets must move from seasonal response to long-term landscape, community and grid adaptation
en-US.intro: Research warns that European wildfires could still increase by about 39% under an optimistic climate scenario; governments need to expand beyond suppression into fuel management, warnings, evacuation, building standards and power-grid resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When the risk curve rises for decades, the most effective investment often happens before flames appear.
en-US.doudouQuote: One more firebreak can mean one less evacuation route.

sources.title: European wildfires could increase 39 percent even in best case

zh-CN.headlineFact: Muon Space融资2.5亿美元扩大卫星制造
zh-CN.headlineView: 气候与地球观测正在从单星项目转向可重复生产的平台能力
zh-CN.headlineFull: Muon Space融资2.5亿美元扩大卫星制造；气候与地球观测正在从单星项目转向可重复生产的平台能力
zh-CN.intro: 卫星公司Muon Space获得2.5亿美元融资，用于扩大生产和部署能力；当遥感需求增长，竞争焦点正从一次性任务转向标准化卫星平台、制造节拍、在轨数据质量和客户交付。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 商业航天真正规模化，要把每一次发射前的复杂工程变成可重复的制造系统。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一颗卫星是项目，一条稳定产线才是平台。

en-US.headlineFact: Muon Space raised $250 million to expand satellite manufacturing
en-US.headlineView: climate and Earth observation are moving from one-off spacecraft to repeatable platform capacity
en-US.headlineFull: Muon Space raised $250 million to expand satellite manufacturing; climate and Earth observation are moving from one-off spacecraft to repeatable platform capacity
en-US.intro: Satellite company Muon Space raised $250 million to expand production and deployment; as remote-sensing demand grows, competition is shifting from individual missions to standardized spacecraft, manufacturing cadence, data quality and customer delivery.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Commercial space scales when complex pre-launch engineering becomes a repeatable manufacturing system.
en-US.doudouQuote: One satellite is a project; a reliable production line is a platform.

sources.title: Muon Space raises 250 million dollars to ramp satellite production
